name_input: Alisha Coils and Transformers A Division Of Cosmo Ferrites Ltd
note: Registry verification incomplete - search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned connection refused for all queries, and registry aggregators (zaubacorp, thecompanycheck) returned HTTP 403, so CIN, PAN, GSTIN, incorporation date, MCA status and audited revenue could NOT be confirmed from official filings; all such fields set to null rather than guessed. What IS confirmed from the company's own website (cosmoferrites.com, fetched): the legal entity 'Cosmo Ferrites Limited' exists and is active as a soft-ferrite core manufacturer (own plant in the Himalayas, 3600 MT installed capacity, 300+ employees, turnover stated as ~INR 1005 million / USD 12.5 million - a self-reported figure, NOT an audited FY25/FY26 number, therefore not used). It is a listed company publishing quarterly results and annual reports under SEBI LODR on its Investor Relations pages (cosmoferrites.com/investor-relations/financial-performance lists results up to quarter ended 30.06.2026), which confirms it is a live, filing entity - not struck off or liquidated. Contact address given on site: 517, 5th Floor, DLF Tower-A, Jasola New District Centre, New Delhi 110025 (corporate/sales office); manufacturing plant is in Himachal Pradesh per site description, so registered-office state could not be pinned down - null. 'Alisha Coils and Transformers' appears to be a division/brand of Cosmo Ferrites, not a separate legal entity; no separate CIN found. Role: manufacturer (own production facility, not a trader). Declared HS 850490 (parts of transformers/inductors) is broadly consistent with ferrite cores, but HS was not the object of this check. No rejection grounds found: entity exists and is operational.
